hello.speaker: slate
hello.text: Well, well. A Clan kit, sniffing about by the river.

choices.text: What are you doing on our land?

fern_question.speaker: fern
fern_question.text: What are you doing on our land?

question_1.speaker: slate
question_1.text: Your land? The river doesn't care whose land it is.

question_2.speaker: slate
question_2.text: Your Clan cat? He's having a nice rest. With friends.

choices.text: Why is there red on your fur?

end_question.speaker: slate
end_question.text: Wouldn't you like to know. I've got places to be.

choices.text: Why is there red on your fur?

bribe_1.speaker: slate
bribe_1.text: Hm. Not bad, for Clan prey.

choices.text: Why is there red on your fur?

end_bribe.speaker: slate
end_bribe.text: Take the old trail east, past your border. Don't say I sent you.

fern_red.speaker: fern
fern_red.text: Why is there red on your fur?

red.speaker: slate
red.text: This? Ask your friend. He didn't come quietly.

go_away.speaker: slate
go_away.text: You got what you came for. Now get lost.
